abstract: Functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) allows noninvasive measurement of neural activity with high spatial resolution. However, fMRI data are affected by noise. Here we introduce and evaluate a denoising method (DeepCor) that utilizes deep generative models to disentangle and remove noise. The method is applicable to data from single participants. DeepCor outperforms other state-of-the-art denoising approaches on a variety of simulated datasets. In real fMRI data, DeepCor enhances BOLD signal responses to face stimuli, outperforming CompCor by 215%.
